chars.SON: a Moroccan man around 28, short dark hair, neatly trimmed short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with white drawstrings and dark blue jeans
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her mid 50s, wearing a burgundy velvet djellaba with gold embroidery down the front, a cream-coloured headscarf, gold bangles on her wrist
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan woman around 30 with long wavy brown hair and no headscarf, wearing a teal denim jacket over a white top

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. In a Tetouan apartment living room with white walls and green zellige tiles, MOM stands in the doorway with her arms tightly crossed, shaking her head firmly, eyebrows raised, refusing; seen from where her son stands, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, centred.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. Moroccan kitchen: MOM turns to SON with a stern, shocked face, one hand raised palm out as if saying no, SON stands in front of her looking nervous, hands open. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. MOM sits on a Moroccan sofa holding a smartphone, frowning disapprovingly at a photo on the screen; next to her, as a floating soft-edged thought bubble, GIRL smiles with her long hair loose. MOM's face visible and centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. Moroccan living room with banquette sofas: SON leans forward pleading with both hands together, MOM turns her head away from him with her nose up, offended. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. SON stands in the living room speaking earnestly with one hand on his chest, defending someone; MOM sits on the sofa in the background listening with an unconvinced look. SON in the centre, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. Close-up from the waist up of MOM wagging her index finger in warning, eyes narrowed, lips pursed, in a Moroccan living room with green zellige behind her. Face centred and visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. SON stands up from the sofa, determined, pointing at the front door; MOM sits shocked with her hand over her mouth. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. SON sits beside MOM on the sofa, calmer, explaining with open hands; MOM listens, her angry face starting to soften, thinking. Tea glasses on a small round table. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat illustration, vertical. MOM's face from the chest up, eyebrows raised high and eyes wide in sudden recognition, one hand lifted to her chin, as if she just realised who the girl is. Moroccan living room behind her, soft evening light. Face centred.
